project.name: Upper canyon fuel break (sample)
project.goal: Build a shaded fuel break along the upper canyon road, above the homes, by next fall, working with the people who live, work, and go to school in the canyon.

people.json: {"goal": "Build a shaded fuel break along the upper canyon road, above the homes, by next fall, working with the people who live, work, and go to school in the canyon.", "a": ["Nobody on the upper road has been asked what they think, so a plan made elsewhere feels like it's being done to us.", "Some of us oppose any cutting we didn't ask for, especially close to the houses, and a few won't let crews on their land.", "", "", "Walk the line with residents before anything is marked, and let each household see what happens on their lot.", "Neighbour-to-neighbour visits, the fire department breakfasts, and a chipping day on our road.", "A named person to call, a printed map, and dates we can plan around."], "m": [[2, 79, 168, "Nobody has told us who decides where the line runs.", null, 2, 2, "Residents", "p13n0", "Person 13"], [2, 96, 194, "The chainsaws by the houses have people up in arms.", null, 0, 2, "Residents", "p13n1", "Person 13"], [2, 61, 215, "Outside agencies don't get to tell us what to do on our land.", null, 4, 0, "Residents", "p13n2", "Person 13"], [1, 29, 195, "I only come up on weekends in summer.", null, 3, 1, "Residents", "p13n3", "Person 13"], [3, 95, 45, "The fire chief came to our potluck and answered every question.", null, 1, 2, "Residents", "p13n4", "Person 13"], [5, 195, 94, "Clearing around my propane tank was easy once someone showed me how.", null, 1, 3, "Residents", "p13n5", "Person 13"], [6, 220, 187, "Last time a crew came through, they left the gate open and my horses got out.", null, 2, 2, "Residents", "p13n6", "Person 13"], [7, 255, 197, "I would read a one-page update; anything longer I skip.", null, 3, 3, "Residents", "p13n7", "Person 13"], [1, 30, 81, "The church hall is free for community meetings.", null, 1, 0, "Residents", "p13n8", "Person 13"]], "p": {"m": []}, "voices": ["Residents"], "links": [], "decisions": {}, "others": [], "who": "Person 13", "log": []}
